body:
Implements ADR-015 (docs/decisions/015-text-wrapping.md).

## Summary

Text does not wrap today (long paragraphs overflow past the viewport) and whitespace does not collapse (source indentation renders literally). This adds whitespace collapsing, direction detection, word-level line breaking, and multi-line LayoutText.

## Scope

### Change 1: Data model (layout_box.hpp)

Add LineFragment struct: x, y, width, height, text.

Extend LayoutText:
- std::vector<LineFragment> lines
- bool rtl
- Bounding box width = max line width; height = sum of line heights
- x, y = top-left of first line

### Change 2: Whitespace collapsing (layout.cpp)

Helper collapse_whitespace(text) -> string:
- Runs of space, tab, newline, CR, form feed collapse to single space
- Trim leading and trailing whitespace
- U+00A0 (nbsp) preserved as non-collapsing, non-breaking

### Change 3: Direction detection (layout.cpp)

Helper detect_rtl(collapsed_text) -> bool, first-strong heuristic.
RTL ranges: U+0600-06FF, U+0750-077F, U+08A0-08FF, U+FB50-FDFF,
U+FE70-FEFF, U+0590-05FF, U+0700-074F, U+0780-07BF, U+07C0-07FF,
U+1E900-1E95F. Otherwise LTR.

### Change 4: Line breaking (layout.cpp)

Helper break_into_lines(collapsed, rtl, font, max_width, measurer)
-> vector<LineFragment>:
- Tokenize on whitespace
- Greedy: measure each word, append if fits, else new line
- Long word overflow: single word takes own line, overflows
- Measure via TextMeasurer seam
- x based on rtl: LTR at content_x, RTL at content_x + content_w - width
- Advance y by previous line height

### Change 5: Paint multi-line (paint.cpp, pango_text.cpp)

- pango_text.cpp: draw_line_with_pango(cairo_t*, LineFragment, LayoutText)
- paint.cpp: iterate text_node.lines, call drawer per fragment

### Change 6: Tests

- test_layout.cpp: whitespace collapsing, direction detection, line breaking (short fits, long wraps, RTL wrap, long-word overflow)
- test_paint.cpp: multi-line text draws at correct y positions

## Behavior (before / after)

Container 800px, 200-char sentence:
  Before: one line, extends past 800 (clipped)
  After: 2-3 lines, all within 800

Container 400px, Arabic paragraph:
  Before: one line, extends past 400
  After: 2+ lines, words RTL-ordered, right-aligned

Text "   Multiple\n  spaces  ":
  Before: literal whitespace rendered
  After: "Multiple spaces"

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] LayoutText has lines vector and rtl flag
- [ ] Whitespace collapses per white-space: normal
- [ ] Direction via first-strong heuristic
- [ ] Line breaking greedy, uses TextMeasurer seam
- [ ] RTL lines right-aligned, LTR left-aligned
- [ ] Paint iterates line fragments
- [ ] All existing 165 tests pass
- [ ] New tests: 8+ layout, 1-2 paint
- [ ] grep -rl "lexbor/" src/ returns only src/renderer/html/convert.cpp
- [ ] CI green

## Three-commit plan

- Commit 1: whitespace collapsing + direction detection helpers + tests
- Commit 2: line breaking + LayoutText changes + tests
- Commit 3: paint multi-line + tests

Each commit builds and passes tests independently.

## Deferred (per ADR-015)

display: inline; full UAX #9 bidi; white-space pre variants; line-height property; text-align; hyphenation; CJK breaking; overflow-wrap; dir attribute.

## Refs

- ADR-015: docs/decisions/015-text-wrapping.md
- ADR-011: docs/decisions/011-first-paint.md
- ADR-014: docs/decisions/014-ua-stylesheet.md
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement text wrapping and whitespace collapsing per ADR-015
